onePageSummary: ‘The Mystery of Food’ is treated as an inquiry-based learning unit. The chapter connects what food contains, balanced meals, food preservation, microorganisms and spoilage, safe food practices. Learners observe the situation, identify evidence, explain relationships, consider consequences and apply the learning to a new context without reproducing textbook wording.

Define or explain local food habits.

Define or explain observation and evidence.
Define or explain cause and consequence.
